public_profile.coverage_note: 美国证监会收录的2026年MINISO股东通函确认Long-Z原名美团龙珠资本，并披露创始合伙人朱拥华负责整体投资及其此前履历。TechCrunch于2026年5月引述Long-Z代表称其领投月之暗面融资。公开资料未核实到龙珠独立的项目投递邮箱；美团投资者关系邮箱不作为融资联系方式。此档案仅涵盖Long-Z，不将美团集团的其他战投并入其投资组合。
public_profile.summary: 美团龙珠（Long-Z）是风险投资基金。MINISO向美国证监会提交的2026年股东通函称，该基金此前名为Meituan DragonBall Capital，并记载朱拥华自2017年1月起担任创始合伙人、负责整体投资。2026年5月，TechCrunch引述Long-Z代表称其领投月之暗面一轮融资；该单笔案例不代表基金完整业绩或完整组合。

facts.label: 机构性质及名称沿革
facts.value: 风险投资基金；Long-Z此前名为Meituan DragonBall Capital（美团龙珠资本）。

facts.label: 投资负责人
facts.value: SEC收录的公司股东通函称，朱拥华自2017年1月起担任创始合伙人并负责Long-Z整体投资。

facts.label: 与美团的关系
facts.value: TechCrunch称Long-Z是美团的风险投资部门；SEC收录的股东通函同时披露朱拥华担任美团副总裁。该关系不代表美团集团每一笔投资都由Long-Z执行。

milestones.description: SEC收录的2026年股东通函记载朱拥华自2017年1月起担任Long-Z创始合伙人并负责整体投资；该日期是其任职起点，不据此推定基金法律主体的成立日。

track_record.description: TechCrunch报道称，月之暗面2026年5月融资约20亿美元、估值约200亿美元；金额及估值依据该报道转述的财务顾问披露。
TechCrunch引述Long-Z代表称，Long-Z领投了月之暗面2026年5月融资。
融资来源记录：Moonshot AI · 轮次未披露 · 2026-06-08 · 2026年5月轮次领投 · 20亿美元。这是本库收录的披露案例，不代表完整投资组合。

sources.source_title: MINISO 2026股东通函｜Long-Z及朱拥华履历
sources.quote: Mr. Zhu has been the founding partner of Long-Z (formerly known as Meituan DragonBall Capital), a venture capital fund, since January 2017 in charge of the overall investment of Long-Z and a vice president of Meituan (HKEX: 3690) (formerly known as Meituan Dianping).

sources.source_title: MINISO 2026股东通函｜朱拥华天图投资经历
sources.quote: Mr. Zhu worked at Tiantu Capital, an investment management company, from July 2007 to October 2014 including as a partner from December 2013 to October 2014.

sources.source_title: MINISO 2026股东通函｜朱拥华联想控股经历
sources.quote: Mr. Zhu served as an executive director of the department of investment in modern agriculture and food at Legend Holdings Corporation (HKEX: 3396), a leading industrial investment and operations company in China listed on the Main Board of the HKEX, from November 2014 to December 2016.

sources.source_title: MINISO 2026股东通函｜朱拥华教育经历
sources.quote: Mr. Zhu received a master’s degree in finance from Newcastle University in the United Kingdom in December 2005.

sources.source_title: MINISO 2026股东通函｜朱拥华董事职务
sources.quote: Mr. ZHU Yonghua (朱擁華), aged 45, has served as our independent Director since October 2020 and was re-designated as an independent non-executive Director with effect from the Listing Date.

sources.source_title: China’s Moonshot AI raises $2B at $20B valuation｜TechCrunch
sources.quote: Moonshot AI, the Beijing-based AI lab developing the popular Kimi series of open-weight large language models, has raised about $2 billion at a valuation of $20 billion, according to a post by Huafeng Capital.

sources.source_title: China’s Moonshot AI raises $2B at $20B valuation｜TechCrunch
sources.quote: The round was led by Chinese food delivery company Meituan’s VC arm, Long-Z Investments, a spokesperson told TechCrunch.
